# WEEKLY ATOMIC SHOP UPDATE: MARCH 14-21

Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/29pmt7e1fe7YQX53ZIzPpm/fce6b88d6fdfcdad7ff3b3772ef9948d/OwlCagefo1st_1920_870_.png)

Until **21. March** you can get your C.A.M.P. Beautify with the Vault-Tec radiant crown floor and the matching foundations from the Atomic Shop - free of charge.

With the owl in the cage, you can be sure that this month it won't suddenly be said that it has fledged.

*Because she never will*.

Until **4. April** free for all Fallout 1st members!
